goal: Make ColdLion master change logging use one set-based latest-prior lookup per table so a changed item snapshot cannot perform one ordered change-log scan per row.
dispatcher: Codex non-orchestrator repository-maintenance session for issue #3295
prohibited_actions: Do not change any migration, database object, timeout, workflow schedule, or live database row.
Do not weaken or remove change-log audit payloads, target proof, transaction atomicity, or failure reporting.
Do not touch issue #3179, issue #3180, or the prepack loader.
assumptions: Production keeps its existing 120-second statement timeout.
The latest prior new_raw row remains the preferred previous_raw audit payload, falling back to the current table projection when no prior change exists.
stop_conditions: Stop if preserving audit semantics requires a database-structure change.
Stop on any gate refusal rather than weakening the gate.
Stop if the implementation needs a file outside allowed_paths.
